title: nfl.receipt.v1 - witness receipt NFL issues for an ingested nfl.ingest.v1 envelope
description: One line per witnessed envelope in NFL's proofs/receipts/nfl.receipt.v1.ndjson (append-only, chained by prev_receipt_sha256 = SHA-256 of the previous line without its LF; 64 zeros first). receipt_id = SHA-256 of the compact JSON {"pointers":[...],"receipt_time":"..."}. Producers fetch it with GET /receipts?packet_id=<id> or the CLI and may record it on their side (RunLedger: event nfl.receipt.ingested.v1). Rows written by a producer for itself in standalone mode carry authoritative=false and their own witness id; only witness='nfl' with authoritative=true is NFL's word.

pointers.description: NFL issues, in order: packet_id (CPR-verified), declared_packet_id (only when the envelope's differs), commit_hash, ledger_record_hash (record hash of the ledger line, nfl.ledger.core.canon.v1).
